app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

final_report.root_cause: Frontend pod was misconfigured to call the frontend Service itself: the frontend container has FRONTEND_ADDR=frontend:8080. The Kubernetes Service named 'frontend' selects the same frontend pod, so DNS name 'frontend' resolves back to the calling pod, producing an unintended self-call/request loop (request amplification). This loop manifested as alternating hops between frontend and frontend-proxy in traces and produced very high latency (~15s) and has_error=true. Envoy (frontend-proxy) logs and Service/pod listings show the proxy itself was not misrouting traffic — the failure is a frontend configuration error.
